svg.title: scNPM: shared-reference propensity matching and posterior network contrasts
svg.desc: Three-stage scNPM workflow with clean directional title bands on all three panels. Independent pre-freeze updates and paired post-freeze updates have equal frames and aligned bold stage titles. Stage arrows have matching dimensions; the freezing route ends with a visible vertical stem. The retained-sampling arrow is extended. Mathematical notation, data and biological illustrations are preserved. Panel gutters are equal, title arrow shoulders align with body corners, and the contrast panel background extends behind both biological illustrations.

g.text: 1:1 matching: min max SMD → min total SMD
